body.purpose: UI text and prose. Geist 400, 14px base.

numeric.purpose: Every digit-bearing cell. JetBrains Mono, tabular-nums slashed-zero.

shadows.name: shadow-universal-x-small
shadows.purpose: Applied on card hover only, paired with a -2px lift. Never at rest.

shadows.name: background-blur

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Decelerating standard easing — no bounce, no elastic.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: none; padding: 20px; transition: box-shadow 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.16); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06), 0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-kicker { margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #8d8d8d; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 6px; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; color: #202020; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: #646464; }

components.name: Primary Metric
components.description: The headline live figure — info-blue marks Total Market Cap and the Stability Index.
components.css: .ds-metric { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; } .ds-metric-label { font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8d8d8d; } .ds-metric-value { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 2.45rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #0090ff; }

components.name: Numeric Cell
components.description: Right-aligned tabular figure used in every data column.
components.css: .ds-numeric { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', SFMono-Regular, ui-monospace, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums slashed-zero; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: #202020; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Category/grade tag — text on a ~16% alpha tint of its own hue. Purple shown; status hues follow the same pattern. No left-stripe.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: rgba(142,78,198,0.16); color: #8145b5; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Pill (default + active)
components.description: Neutral interactive control. Active state is a quiet near-black ink fill — never info-blue or purple.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.8); font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #646464; cursor: pointer; transition: color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-pill:hover { color: #202020; background: #f0f0f0; } .ds-pill:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fcfcfc, 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,144,255,0.55); } .ds-pill-active { background: #202020; color: #fcfcfc; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Segmented Control (density)
components.description: The two-mode density toggle — spacious / compact — and similar segmented switches.
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; padding: 2px; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.1); border-radius: 8px; background: #f0f0f0; gap: 2px; } .ds-seg-opt { padding: 5px 12px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; font-family: 'Geist', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #646464; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-seg-opt:hover { color: #202020; } .ds-seg-on { background: #ffffff; color: #202020; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.06); }

narrative.overview: Pharos is a precision instrument for crypto-native practitioners — a Bloomberg Terminal scoped to stablecoins. The interface is monochrome by default: a neutral Radix-gray field where the chrome recedes and the data leads. Color is rationed and always means something — a Radix status hue (peg health, risk, trend), the info-blue that marks the primary live metrics, or a quiet purple categorical tag. Nothing is colored for decoration. Light-default with a full dark theme, navigated by a global top-nav with full-width content (no sidebar; the frost-blue lighthouse identity is retired). Rebuilt from a professional designer's Figma against a Radix-based component library.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome neutral base (Radix gray); color appears only as status, the primary metric, or a categorical tag.
Global top-nav, full-width content. No sidebar.
Flat cards: fill + hairline border, no resting shadow. Depth is a hover response.
Mono + tabular + slashed-zero on every digit-bearing cell.
Fixed rem type scale; two-mode density (spacious / compact).
Color is reinforced with structure and iconography, never the sole signal.

rules.name: The Monochrome-Default Rule
rules.body: The interface is neutral. A color only appears if it is carrying a status, the primary metric, or a categorical tag. Any other saturation is wrong.

rules.name: The Quiet-Purple Rule
rules.body: Purple is a categorical accent at the edges (readiness, the active entry card, category tags) — never page chrome, never a button fill, never a gradient.

rules.name: The Semantic-Status Rule
rules.body: The Radix status ramp encodes state only. Inactive states never take a full-saturation hue; badges sit on ~16% alpha tints and route through shared/lib/classification.ts.

rules.name: The Tabular-Figure Rule
rules.body: Numbers always use JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums slashed-zero. Proportional digits in a data column are a bug.

rules.name: The Fixed-Scale Rule
rules.body: Headings use the fixed rem scale, not fluid clamp(). The viewport changes layout, not type size.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. A shadow appears only as a response to state — hover, an overlay, or a deliberately featured block. Nested cards are forbidden.

dos: Do keep the interface monochrome (Radix gray); spend color only on status, the primary metric (info-blue), or a categorical purple tag.
Do use the Radix status ramp — Good #30a46c, Alert #ffe629, Warning #f76b15, Danger #e5484d — with badges on ~16% alpha tints, routed through shared/lib/classification.ts.
Do keep purple minor and categorical (readiness, active entry card, category tags), flat, never a CTA.
Do render every digit with JetBrains Mono + tabular-nums slashed-zero.
Do keep cards flat: surface-raised fill + 1px hairline, no resting shadow; lift only on hover.
Do use the global top-nav with full-width content; keep the fixed rem type scale and two-mode density.
Do gate every animation behind prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't reintroduce frost-blue #4bc4de as a brand accent, or the lighthouse beam / watch-column sidebar — that identity is retired.
Don't use border-left/right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe (retired app-wide).
Don't ship Web3-marketing tropes: purple gradients, glassmorphism cards, gradient text, or buzzwords. Purple as a flat categorical tag is fine; purple as chrome or gradient is not.
Don't fall into corporate-fintech blandness or the generic-SaaS grid of interchangeable KPI tiles.
Don't reskin DefiLlama or a generic trading-terminal clone.
Don't give info-blue or purple to controls, inactive states, or decoration.
Don't put a resting drop shadow on a card, or nest a card inside a card.
Don't use fluid clamp() headings or proportional figures in a data column.
Don't reorder the homepage bands, or introduce a new serif outside the authored editorial carve-out.
